research_question: On capability, safety, and human-preference evaluations, do ChatGPT (GPT-4-class) models outperform Anthropic Claude models, or does the ranking depend on task family?

stance_definitions.supports: evidence that ChatGPT or GPT-4-class models outperform Claude on capability, coding, reasoning, preference, or safety metrics
stance_definitions.contradicts: evidence that Claude matches or outperforms ChatGPT, or that which model is better depends on task family rather than a global ranking
